title: Retrieve a napkin from under a vase

robot_resolution.note: Primary installed library robot model available.

assets.genie_license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (AgiBot Genie Sim Assets; local meshes/textures kept private, videos & metrics public)

verification_methodology.disclosure: Free-body native Genie vase (`benchmark_vase_001`) resting on the corner of a physical sliding cloth napkin on a dining table (`benchmark_table_002`). Under MuJoCo gravity and Coulomb friction, pulling the napkin transfers horizontal shear and overturning torque to the vase base. Safe TIAGo Dual senses initial resistance/vase tilt (> 3 deg), eases tension, stabilizes/lifts the vase with its left gripper, and slides the napkin cleanly free; unsafe TIAGo Dual keeps pulling upward and outward with one arm, dragging and tipping the vase over onto the dining table.
